legalIntegrityDisposition: Official layout and labels are the official bytes. Only participant and deterministic values are added. Court-assigned hearing details, signatures and court-use blocks are never populated. The form field names prefixed Protected are California confidential-contact-information fields supplied by the participant, not court-use fields.

bindings.note: The form pre-prints "Superior Court of California, County of" above this block; binding a full court name duplicated it. This widget is an 89-point multi-line block for the county plus the court street address.
The form pre-prints "People of the State of California v."; only the defendant name belongs here.

en.formPurpose: CR-409 is the petition asking the court to seal your arrest record because the arrest did not lead to a conviction.
en.whatYouDo: Check your details, sign and date the petition, and file it in the county where the arrest happened.
en.whatWeDoNotDo: LegalEase does not set your hearing date, does not sign for you, and does not complete anything reserved to the court or clerk.
en.noCheckout: This form is not available for purchase. It is prepared for review only.

es.formPurpose: El CR-409 es la peticion que solicita al tribunal sellar su registro de arresto porque el arresto no resulto en una condena.
es.whatYouDo: Verifique sus datos, firme y feche la peticion, y presentela en el condado donde ocurrio el arresto.
es.whatWeDoNotDo: LegalEase no fija la fecha de su audiencia, no firma por usted, y no completa nada reservado al tribunal o al secretario.
es.noCheckout: Este formulario no esta disponible para la compra. Se prepara unicamente para revision.
